svg.title: Sonya Raber and Floyd Balliet: family links and the original 1940 household
svg.desc: On the left, the original 1950 census names Sonya as William John Raber's daughter, and a Social Security index names his parents William G. Raber and Alice L. Houser. On the right, an original 1940 census names Crystal Balliet and eleven children, including a one-year-old Floyd. Justin identifies Stanley and Crystal as Sonya's Floyd's parents. The dotted arrow marks that family identification, still awaiting an independent adult-to-child record.
